decisions.reason: As the broader adjacent supplement line with several variants, it remains a low-cost strategic option in consumer health and is worth keeping unless clearly weak demand is revealed.
This hair-and-skin supplement fits the firm's pharmacy-based portfolio expansion and, without a clear negative signal, still merits retention at modest carrying cost.
The joint-health supplement is an adjacent, relatively inexpensive product to carry, so we keep it while continuing to test whether its market value is sufficient for longer-term commitment.

For this more distant OTC migraine product, enough time has passed that uncertainty should be largely resolved, and without stronger evidence of payoff we would free resources for the core business and new development.
